title: M3MAD-Bench: Are Multi-Agent Debates Really Effective Across Domains and Modalities?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark, M3MAD-Bench, measures the effectiveness of Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) methods across five core domains: Knowledge, Mathematics, Medicine, Natural Sciences, and Complex Reasoning.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
